gaps.title: Unified Cold‑Chain Visibility & Compliance
gaps.detail: While Lactalis India uses IoT‑enabled smart tech with DHL SmarTrucking, it lacks a single, real‑time monitoring platform that covers all dairy products, fleets and compliance reporting for Indian regulations.
gaps.based_on: Lactalis India partnered with DHL SmarTrucking to provide customized cold‑chain transportation for its two Indian dairy companies, using IoT‑enabled smart technology for temperature accuracy and faster transit.

gaps.title: IoT‑Driven Warehouse & Inventory Visibility
gaps.detail: The company describes a state‑of‑the‑art plant and cutting‑edge technology, yet there is no indication of real‑time, sensor‑based inventory tracking across its cold storage and distribution warehouses.
gaps.based_on: Lactalis India describes itself as an integrated milk and dairy products company in India with a state‑of‑the‑art plant, cutting‑edge technology and stringent quality standards.

gaps.title: Comprehensive Asset Tracking for Fleet & Equipment
gaps.detail: Reliance on an external logistics partner suggests limited internal visibility of dairy processing equipment and delivery vehicles, risking loss, theft, or sub‑optimal utilization.
gaps.based_on: Lactalis India partnered with DHL SmarTrucking to provide customized cold‑chain transportation for its two Indian dairy companies, using IoT‑enabled smart technology for temperature accuracy and faster transit.

pitch.angle:
- Highlight how extending the existing IoT partnership into a unified ThinxFresh dashboard can give Lactalis India end‑to‑end temperature, location and compliance visibility.
- Offer a single platform to digitise cold‑storage and warehouse inventory, cutting manual counts and reducing waste.
- Introduce lightweight asset‑tracking tags for processing equipment and delivery trucks to safeguard high‑value assets and improve fleet utilisation.
- Position these efficiencies as a direct accelerator toward their US$1 billion growth target in India.
pitch.opener: Congrats on the DHL SmarTrucking partnership—let’s discuss turning that IoT boost into a company‑wide cold‑chain intelligence platform.
